response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count, SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count FROM per_type) SELECT p.trader_type, p.transaction_count, 1.0 * p.transaction_count / totals.total_count AS share_of_transactions, p.transaction_count - totals.average_count AS above_average_by FROM per_type AS p CROSS JOIN totals WHERE p.transaction_count > totals.average_count;
